Role Summary
 Responsibilities : You will take a leading role across a variety of scientific projects in the Value and Access team, using your expertise to deliver high-quality projects and build client relationships. As an early member of each of these growing teams, you will work closely with team leads and other senior colleagues to drive business development, while having opportunities to directly oversee and manage junior team members, supporting their development as we expand our presence and impact in Canada and the US
 Salary : A starting salary of CAD $90,000 – CAD $100,000 per annum, depending on previous experience (please note that we have established salary bands that are determined by your level of educational attainment to ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations)
 Benefits : Hybrid and flexible working options, generous vacation allowance, private health and dental insurance, life insurance, RRSP/TFSA plan with up to a 5% employer contribution, full funding and study leave for external training and more
 Role Type : Full-time; permanent
 Start Date : We are currently recruiting for start dates throughout 2026, which occur on a monthly basis, and you will be asked to state your availability on your application form
 Application Deadlines: While there are no set application deadlines, we strongly recommend applying as early as possible. The role, or particular start dates, may close when a suitable candidate is found
 Location : This role is available in our Vancouver office 
 About the Role 
 As a Senior Analyst within our Canadian Value and Access team, you will play a leading role in the delivery of market access, HTA and health economics projects for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. You will work alongside Team Heads, Consultants, Analysts and Project Coordinators to deliver high-quality projects that support reimbursement and access decisions across Canada. 
 Projects may include the development of HTA submission packages for CDA-AMC and INESSS, writing up economic evaluations and budget impact analyses, reimbursement strategy, evidence generation planning, value communication materials and other market access deliverables. You will work closely with clients throughout the project lifecycle, including regular interaction over email and in meetings, providing strategic input and ensuring projects are delivered to an exceptionally high standard and within agreed timelines. Senior Analysts are central to the quality of project deliverables and play a key role in training, mentoring and supporting more junior colleagues. Responsibilities include reviewing work, providing constructive feedback and contributing to the ongoing development of the wider project team. 
 As part of Costello Medical's growing Canadian presence, you will primarily work on Canadian projects but you will also have the opportunity to work on international value and access projects with colleagues in our global offices.
 A Day in the Life of a Senior Analyst
 To learn more about a typical day for a Senior Analyst at Costello Medical, please click here: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/day-in-the-life-senior-analyst-us/ 
 Career Profile
 We offer many opportunities for personal and professional development at Costello Medical. Please click below to read firsthand accounts from our colleagues about their time with the company: https://www.costellomedical.com/careers/working-at-costello-medical/ 
 About Costello Medical 
 Costello Medical is a rapidly growing global healthcare agency specializing in medical communications, market access and health economic and outcomes research. We work with a wide range of clients, including the industry’s most successful pharmaceutical companies. We received B Corporation Accreditation in 2022. Please click here to learn more about us, our work and our mission: https://www.costellomedical.com/   
 About You
 We are looking for individuals who are collaborative, self-motivated, and enthusiastic. You will take pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work and building successful client relationships. You will identify and capitalize on opportunities to go above and beyond for clients and exceed their expectations wherever possible. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment, be highly organized, and be able to manage timelines across multiple projects. 
 While we are seeking applications from those who already have at least 2 years’ experience delivering relevant project types within an agency setting, we also are seeking those who are flexible and willing to learn and contribute to a wide variety of areas. You will be expected to work across different accounts spanning multiple disease areas and therefore should be able to familiarize yourself with new information quickly.
 Specifically, we are looking for candidates with the following experience: 
 A degree level or higher qualification in a scientific discipline (minimum GPA 3.3). We welcome applications from candidates with a diverse range of specialties, including but not limited to; biology, chemistry, pharmacy and medicine
 At least 2 years’ professional experience in a consulting, pharmaceuticals, medical devices or public sector role where you analyzed and communicated health data in different formats for key stakeholders. The ideal candidate would have experience working in HEOR within the Canadian setting, such as working on HTA submission packages to CDA-AMC and/or INESSS
 Strong scientific writing skills with the ability to tailor writing style to different audiences
 Exceptional attention to detail and high degree of written accuracy
 Excellent proficiency in written English and arithmetic
 Excellent data presentation skills, including the ability to use Excel, PowerPoint and Word effectively and efficiently to produce a professional, high standard of work
 Sufficient technical and strategic knowledge to provide clients with recommendations on project content and approach
 Experience in communicating directly with clients or key stakeholders, including responding to different communication styles, as well as a proven ability to build robust and sustainable relationships
 The capacity to maintain exceptional customer service and quality of deliverables under multiple competing demands 
 Project management skills to enable timely project delivery
 The ability to motivate colleagues and take a leadership role in the delivery of project components
 Experience in reviewing and providing constructive feedback on junior colleagues’ work, with the aim of supporting them to develop high quality deliverables 
 What We Offer 
 Alongside our award-winning company culture, where every team member is celebrated, respected, and has their voice heard, our comprehensive benefits package includes:
 A starting salary of CAD $90,000 – CAD $100,000 per annum, depending on your qualifications and previous experience. Please note that we have established salary bands that ensure a fair and consistent approach for all applicants, eliminating the need for individual negotiations
 18 days’ vacation leave increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 22 days and 11 statutory holidays
 Flexible, reasonable working hours and the chance to work from home for up to half of your working time
 100% employer covered extended healthcare plan, as well as life insurance and AD&D coverage
 Retirement savings via a RRSP/TFSA plan with up to a 5% employer match
 Paid funding for external education and study leave
 Paid and unpaid sabbaticals based on length of service
 Hybrid Working Policy: We believe that having face-to-face time in the office holds many benefits and is central to ensuring that the community we have created, where people have a workplace they belong to and feel part of, is never lost. At the same time, we recognize that working from home can improve work life balance, reduce commuting times and costs, and provide the opportunity to juggle personal commitments. 
 Therefore, we offer flexible working arrangements that allow our colleagues to work from home for up to half of the time, measured across a 2-week rolling period. 
 The Application Process
 You are required to submit your resume and a cover letter via our online application form. In your cover letter, you must explain why you think you would be suited to the role and why you would like to join Costello Medical, with examples to support both. Your resume should clearly state the dates of all qualifications and grades achieved where applicable.
 Our recruitment process includes a telephone interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team followed by a proofreading and technical assessment for you to complete in your own time. If successful, you will be invited to an interview which will include a short presentation you can prepare for in advance. Our standard recruitment process lasts around 6 weeks; however, this can be adapted if necessary.
 As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce and, throughout the recruitment process, there are a number of reasonable adjustments we can provide. Please click here to learn more.
 Please note that, while we embrace AI to innovate and improve processes, it is important for us to assess your own critical thinking, technical skills and writing ability, so we recommend that you do not rely solely on this technology to generate any application materials.
 Visa Sponsorship
 We welcome applications from international candidates, but we are unfortunately unable to provide sponsorship for work permits. Therefore, you must have the right to work in Canada independently from the company. However, we are able to consider those on a temporary work permit, for example an IEC visa.

Lead Product Manager, Live Games
 Toronto, ON
Hybrid, 4 days per week in office
Full-time
Department: Product
Reports to: Product and Studio Leadership
Compensation range: CAD $140,000 to $170,000
 About Big Viking Games
 Big Viking Games is a Canadian gaming company focused on building, operating, and growing long-standing online game communities. Our games have entertained players for years, supported by loyal audiences, live operations, evolving content systems, product innovation, and a deep understanding of player behavior.
 Our live-service games have served millions of players over their lifetime. These are enduring social game experiences with loyal communities, meaningful live revenue, rich in-game economies, virtual goods, player-to-player interaction, and long-term engagement at their core.
 We are entering a new phase of modernization and growth, with a focus on stronger product discipline, better data visibility, smarter live operations, practical AI adoption, and scalable systems that help our games and teams perform at a higher level.
 About the Role
 Big Viking Games is hiring a Lead Product Manager, Live Games to help shape the next stage of growth for one of our long-running social games.
 This is a high-impact product leadership role for someone who understands live games, player behavior, monetization, experimentation, content performance, game economies, and durable product systems.
 You will work closely with leadership, design, engineering, data, art, production, and live operations to improve the current player experience while helping define the game’s future across platforms.
 The right person brings strong product judgment, hands-on execution, commercial thinking, and the ability to turn ambiguity into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and shipped improvements.
 This is not a maintenance role. It is a role for someone who wants ownership of a live product with real players, real revenue, and real opportunity.
 The Opportunity
 This game has a strong legacy, an active audience, and significant room for growth.
 We are looking for a product leader who can identify the biggest opportunities, make clear tradeoffs, and turn product strategy into measurable results.
 You will help modernize how the game operates, improve the player experience, strengthen monetization systems, and guide the roadmap for both the current live game and future expansion opportunities.
 The challenge is to build a smarter, more data-informed, more scalable version of the game while respecting the community and product foundations that already exist.
 What You’ll Do
 Own the product strategy and roadmap, with a focus on growth, retention, monetization, player satisfaction, and long-term product health.
 Partner with leadership to define clear goals, priorities, success metrics, and product tradeoffs.
 Analyze player behavior, economy health, feature performance, content performance, live operations, and business trends to identify high-impact opportunities.
 Lead experimentation across offers, events, live operations, onboarding, engagement loops, pricing, bundles, and monetization systems.
 Work closely with design, engineering, art, live operations, production, and data to ship improvements quickly, measure performance, and learn from results.
 Help evolve the game into a stronger multi-platform product while preserving what existing players value most.
 Use AI and automation thoughtfully to improve workflows, accelerate analysis, reduce manual effort, and help the team move faster.
 Translate player feedback, community signals, market awareness, and data into practical product decisions.
 Build repeatable product processes that improve planning, prioritization, execution, measurement, and post-launch learning.
 Bring structure, clarity, and accountability to roadmap planning, feature evaluation, live operations planning, and product decision-making.
 Partner with data and analytics to define the right metrics, dashboards, experiments, and reporting needed to manage the game properly.
 Partner with finance and leadership to understand product performance, revenue risk, monetization opportunities, and return on product investment.
 What You Bring
 6+ years of product management, game product management, product strategy, monetization, growth, or live-service product experience.
 Experience owning or materially influencing a live game, social game, free-to-play product, consumer product, or digital product with meaningful recurring engagement.
 Strong product judgment and a clear point of view on what creates player value, business value, and long-term product health.
 Experience using data to guide product and business decisions.
 Experience running or partnering on A/B tests, feature experiments, live operations tests, pricing tests, offer tests, or engagement initiatives.
 Strong understanding of game economies, virtual currencies, pricing, bundles, offers, events, engagement loops, and monetization systems.

 This position offers an opportunity to play an important role in our mechanical operations, with a primary focus on mechanical inspection, diagnosis, and repair of collision-damaged vehicles .

 0-39 hours/week 
 Contract Role 
 Seasonal Ambassador 
 Seasonal Ambassadors at Lush are experts in product and brand knowledge, as well as providing exceptional customer consultations and product demonstrations. Seasonal Ambassadors cultivate strong team relationships and contribute to overall shop excellence in both sales and operations. On the shop floor, they consistently surpass daily sales goals while creating a fun and inclusive team environment that keeps customers coming back for more. 
 We encourage you to put yourself in the customer's shoes and think about what would make their day. Whether it's providing personalized product recommendations or sharing your knowledge and expertise, you have the power to create a unique and memorable experience for every shopper.
 For our Seasonal Ambassadors, it's not just about selling soap – it's about making a positive impact on the world, one bar at a time!
 Responsibilities: 
 Sales and Customer Experience: 
 Driving Sales: Utilize StoreForce dashboard results and seek feedback to exceed sales goals. Take ownership of your results and actively work to grow your contribution to the store’s overall sales. 
 Customer Experience: Consistently deliver a world-class customer experience to every customer who walks through our doors. Connect with customers and identify their needs by listening attentively and asking open-ended questions. Show off our amazing products by demonstrating their unique benefits and features. Seek opportunities to make customers' day and leave the world Lusher than we found it.
 Building the Brand: Educate customers on our brand values including our stance on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging. Expertly articulate these values in the shop and through community engagement by hosting store parties and other initiatives that help bring in more traffic. Spread the word about what makes Lush unique, and inspire others to join us in making a positive impact on the world!
 Product Passion: Continually expand your product knowledge with ongoing learning and diving deep into all things Lush. Stay up-to-date on our products, ingredients, and unique benefits to confidently and consistently make informed product recommendations for every customer's needs. 
 Team Involvement: 
 Development: Utilize Lush resources to develop effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve your performance, support the growth of your team, and increase sales. Take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge, and abilities. 
 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members’ perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.
 Operational Excellence: 
 Time and Attendance: Be punctual, reliable, and present at work. Actively participate in teamwork, prioritize your wellbeing by taking breaks when necessary, and keep up-to-date with company news and updates.
 Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
 Stock and Inventory: Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales to improve the customer experience.
 Policies and Procedures: Ensure you are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety. 
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Excellent customer service skills 
 Flexibility to adapt to changing situations and priorities in a fast-paced environment 
 Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business 
 Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays 
 Preferred: 
 Experience with consultation-based customer service models 
 Strong problem-solving skills to address issues that arise in day-to-day operations 
 Experience working in a team environment 
 Experience working in skincare or cosmetics 
 Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training 
 Fluency in Spanish, French, or other languages
 Guildford Pay
 $19.50 — $19.50 CAD 
 Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more! 
 We Are Lush 
 YouTube 
 LinkedIn 
 Find our Personal Privacy Policy details here. 
 Lush Handmade Cosmetics participates in E-Verify in certain US states including AL, GA, NC, SC, FL, AZ, UT, TN and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. 
 Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.
Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92 . We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in ally ship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

Aviso : 
 À Aviso, nous nous consacrons à l’amélioration du bien-être financier des Canadiennes et des Canadiens. À titre d’organisation de gestion de patrimoine de premier plan, nous nous engageons à faire preuve de leadership, d’innovation et de responsabilité ainsi qu’à miser sur le partenariat et la communauté. En travaillant avec des professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui incarnent nos valeurs au quotidien, vous constaterez rapidement que ce sont nos employés et notre culture « uneaviso » dynamique qui nous démarquent des autres sociétés. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un emploi intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une entreprise centrée sur son personnel, découvrez ce que Aviso peut vous offrir en consultant le site www.aviso.ca/fr .
 L’occasion: 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un superviseur ou d’une superviseure des transferts bilingue qui se joindra à notre équipe de l’Exploitation.
 Relevant du gestionnaire ou de la gestionnaire, Exploitation, le superviseur ou la superviseure des transferts bilingue est responsable de superviser l’équipe chargée des transferts, de gérer les volumes de travail et de veiller au respect des échéances quotidiennes. Les responsabilités de supervision comprennent le recrutement, la formation, l’encadrement, le mentorat et l’établissement des horaires du personnel, y compris la supervision de l’accueil et de l’intégration des nouveaux employés ainsi que l’évolution de carrière et les possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel.
 En tant qu’uneaviso : 
 Nous prenons soin de vous – Vous faites ce qu’il faut pour la clientèle, les partenaires et les collègues. Vous établissez des relations de confiance, prônez l’excellence du service et contribuez à une culture où chaque personne se sent valorisée et soutenue. 
 Nous osons – Vous remettez en question le statu quo au moyen d’idées audacieuses et de nouvelles perspectives. Vous accueillez le changement, recherchez des occasions d’innovation et êtes à l’aise avec l’exploration de nouvelles méthodes de travail. 
 Nous nous surpassons – Vous collaborez ouvertement et établissez des relations significatives. Vous recherchez des points de vue variés, partagez vos connaissances et travaillez de concert avec les collègues, la clientèle et les partenaires pour les aider à réussir. 
 Nous livrons des résultats – Vous assumez la responsabilité de votre travail, respectez vos engagements et vous concentrez sur la production de résultats concrets. Vous êtes responsable de vos actions et cherchez constamment à vous améliorer. 
 À quoi ressemble votre journée: 
 Fixer des normes pour les procédures du service et en effectuer le suivi, en vue d’assurer la qualité, l’exactitude et l’efficacité du travail dans le respect des contrats de niveau de service
 Créer un climat positif et empreint de leadership en gagnant le respect du personnel, des pairs et des parties intéressées
 S’assurer que les membres du personnel bénéficient d’une formation et d’un perfectionnement appropriés en temps opportun
 Encadrer le personnel en vue d’améliorer le rendement tout en augmentant/maintenant l’engagement des employés ainsi que leur avancement professionnel, et soutenir l’accueil et l’intégration des nouveaux employés
 Veiller à ce que tous les processus et toutes les procédures soient à jour dans tous les manuels – internes et externes, y compris les contrats de niveau de service du service
 Se charger des communications internes et externes en suivant les canaux de distribution appropriés, en faisant la liaison avec les fournisseurs externes et les fiduciaires, le cas échéant
 Analyser les pratiques commerciales actuelles et cerner les domaines dans lesquels le service peut améliorer ses processus, faire des recommandations et mettre en place des procédures pour rationaliser le flux de travail
 Gérer le travail lié aux projets du service et participer à la mise en œuvre d’initiatives du service et de la division, selon les besoins, et déléguer si nécessaire
 Appuyer le personnel dans le cadre de problèmes complexes ou transmis à un échelon supérieur, répondre à toutes les demandes de renseignements des clients (internes et externes) et veiller à ce que les niveaux de service à la clientèle soient maintenus au sein du service, en informant la direction, le cas échéant
 Prévoir les effectifs appropriés ainsi que les besoins de formation et de perfectionnement, y compris la formation polyvalente du personnel de sorte que les employés soient à jour et puissent s’acquitter des tâches exigées dans le cadre de chacun des postes au sein de l’équipe
 Examiner et approuver les écritures de journal quotidiennes et les rapprochements de compte mensuels (OCRCVM et ACCFM)
 Rendre compte tous les mois, en temps opportun, des normes prévues par les contrats de niveau de service, y compris les exceptions, et créer des plans d’affaires pour gérer les ressources en cas de volumes élevés
 Se tenir au courant des initiatives et des normes du secteur (ACCFM et OCRCVM) et actualiser ses connaissances sur les produits de régimes enregistrés, le service NELTC de la CDS, les règles de l’OCRCVM et de l’ACCFM, les lois et les protocoles
 Faire la liaison avec la direction en ce qui concerne les rapports sur les processus et les procédures destinés aux vérificateurs externes et internes, selon les besoins
 Requirements 
 Expérience et compétences demandées : 
 Études postsecondaires et formation continue en lien avec le secteur des placements, plus précisément les fonctions liées aux opérations 
 Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires pertinentes, et CFIC ou CCVM suivi avec succès, un atout
 De trois à cinq ans d’expérience à des niveaux de responsabilité de plus en plus élevés dans le secteur des placements, dont un à deux ans dans un rôle de supervision
 Excellentes compétences en matière de délégation, d’organisation, de gestion du temps et d’administration
 Grand souci du détail et de l’exactitude
 Capacité à travailler sous pression, à établir des priorités et à respecter les contraintes de temps
 Solides compétences analytiques et en résolution de problèmes, et capacité de gérer plusieurs tâches tout en ayant le souci du détail
 Excellentes aptitudes pour le service à la clientèle et capacité à rapidement cerner et résoudre les problèmes d’une manière satisfaisante pour toutes les parties
 Grande motivation, notamment pour l’atteinte des objectifs
 Connaissances informatiques intermédiaires en MS Word, Excel, Outlook et Access. Des compétences avancées sur Excel sont un atout
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication, à la fois en français et en anglais, requises
 Benefits 
 Pourquoi Aviso Wealth ? 
 Chez Aviso Wealth, vous trouverez une culture dynamique et inclusive qui valorise l’innovation et met en valeur les réussites de ses employés.
 Quelques traits qui nous distinguent : 
 Un programme de rémunération concurrentiel qui récompense et valorise les contributions de chacun.
 Des prestations de santé, soins dentaires et une assurance de premier plan pour satisfaire les divers besoins de nos employés
 Des vacances généreuses, des bénéfices de santé et de conditionnement physique, des options complémentaires au congé parental.
 Des cotisations complémentaires pour notre programme de retraite.
 Un engagement à l’amélioration continue de notre personnel au moyen de l’apprentissage et du développement ainsi que d’un programme de soutien à la formation.
 Des événements sociaux organisés régulièrement pour favoriser le travail d’équipe.
 Vos renseignements 
 En soumettant votre candidature, vous consentez à la collecte, à l’utilisation et à la communication des renseignements personnels que vous avez fournis dans le but d’évaluer vos qualifications et votre aptitude à occuper un emploi à Aviso. Vos renseignements seront traités conformément aux lois canadiennes sur la protection des renseignements personnels applicables, notamment la Loi sur la protection des renseignements personnels et les documents électroniques (LPRPDE) et les lois provinciales pertinentes. Vos données peuvent être communiquées au personnel autorisé participant au processus de recrutement et ne seront conservées que pendant la durée nécessaire à ces fins ou conformément à la loi.
 Pour obtenir plus d’informations, consultez le lien sur la Politique de protection des renseignements personnels , qui se trouve sur notre page Carrières.
 Politique d’égalité d’accès à l’emploi 
 Aviso accueille et encourage les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, y compris les candidats/titulaires handicapés. Si vous nécessitez un accommodement, nous travaillerons avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins à toutes les étapes du processus d’embauche.
 Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt, cependant, seules les candidatures retenues pour une étude plus approfondie seront contactées.
 Aucun recruteur ou agence, s’il vous plaît.
 Aperçu de la société 
 Fort d’un actif total sous administration et sous gestion environ 145 milliards de dollars, et d’un effectif de plus de 1 000 employés, Aviso est un important fournisseur de services de gestion de patrimoine et de placement pour le secteur financier canadien. Nous bâtissons un écosystème complet de services de gestion de patrimoine à la fine pointe de la technologie et axé sur les clients. Nos clients comprennent nos partenaires, les conseillers et les investisseurs. Nous sommes un partenaire de confiance pour presque toutes les coopératives d’épargne et de crédit au Canada, en plus de l’être pour un large éventail de gestionnaires de portefeuille, de courtiers en placement, de compagnies d’assurance, de sociétés de fiducie et de courtiers remisiers. Nos partenaires comptent sur Aviso pour leur offrir des solutions bien précises qui leur procurent un avantage concurrentiel dans un secteur en pleine évolution et hautement compétitif. Notre courtier en placement, notre courtier en épargne collective et nos services d’assurance soutiennent des milliers de conseillers en placement. Notre gestionnaire d’actifs est Placements NEI, dont la spécialisation est d’investir de façon responsable. Notre service de courtage en ligne, Qtrade Investissement directMD, renforce le pouvoir des investisseurs autonomes, et notre service de placement entièrement automatisé, Portefeuilles accompagnés QtradeMD, est au service des investisseurs qui préfèrent une approche passive. Partenaires des correspondants Aviso offre des services de garde de biens et de courtier chargé de compte à un large éventail de sociétés. Nous avons des bureaux à Toronto, Vancouver, Montréal et Winnipeg. Aviso est soutenue par la force collective de ses propriétaires : les centrales de caisses de crédit, Co-operators/CUMIS et Desjardins. Nous sommes fiers de propulser les entreprises qui renforcent le pouvoir des investisseurs. 
 Faire carrière à Aviso, c’est faire partie d’un groupe de professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui vivent leurs valeurs au quotidien, et appartenir à une organisation qui se consacre à votre réussite et au développement de votre carrière. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un travail intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une société soucieuse de son personnel, postulez pour faire partie de notre équipe!
 Salaire 
 L’échelle salariale prévue de ce poste est de 83 000 $ à 100 000 $ CA par année. Les conditions de rémunération individuelles sont basées sur divers facteurs propres à chaque candidat et aux exigences du poste.

Aidez-nous à redéfinir le service client à l’ère de l’IA. 
 La plupart des entreprises gèrent encore leur service client avec des systèmes de billetterie conçus en 2007, auxquels on a greffé l’IA après coup.
 Botpress est la plateforme d’agents IA de niveau entreprise pour le service client, conçue dans l’autre sens. Nous voulons redéfinir le quotidien des agents de soutien et tirer le meilleur de ce qu’eux seuls savent vraiment. Nous croyons au pouvoir d’agents humains qualifiés qui pilotent l’IA, plutôt qu’à une IA qui se contente de les épauler.
 Si vous voulez bâtir la plateforme de service client de l’ère de l’IA, nous cherchons les meilleurs talents pour se joindre à nous.
 À propos du poste

ABOUT NEW ENERGY NEXUS
 New Energy Nexus (NEX) is an international NGO that supports climate solutions and builds a more equitable clean energy economy. Our laser focus is on clean energy entrepreneurs: providing them with funds, accelerators, and networks to thrive. They are our main audience and our agent of change.
We started in California in 2004 and now operate across China, India, Southeast Asia, East and West Africa, and Australia. We have leveraged US$5.4 billion in investment and supported more than 11,000 entrepreneurs.
 ABOUT THE ROLE & OPPORTUNITY
 The Director of Development Strategy & Operations will lead the internal engine behind New Energy Nexus' global fundraising and business development efforts. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this role sits at the center of NEX's development team — turning what our development and partnerships staff and country teams learn on the ground with funders into a coherent, prioritized fundraising strategy, and making sure the team is coordinated, resourced, and focused on the highest-value opportunities. 
 This is not primarily a donor-facing relationship management role. It is a strategy, team leadership, and fundraising operations role for someone who understands the business and fund development cycle deeply enough to translate frontline intelligence — what funders are signaling, what's landing and what isn't, where proposals are stalling, which markets and programs are attracting interest — into clear direction for where the team should spend its time.
 The Director will lead and develop NEX's global platform-level development team, ensuring that individual team members' skills and expertise are deployed effectively against organizational priorities, while bringing together the knowledge and fundraising capabilities of country leaders, chapter teams, and program leads. The ideal candidate has the analytical rigor and systems mindset of a strong operations leader, paired with real fluency in philanthropic and development finance fundraising, so they can be a credible internal leader and partner to a globally distributed team of fundraisers, country directors, and program leads.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 Fundraising Strategy & Prioritization (50%) 
 Help develop a living, prioritized development strategy based on proposal outcomes, funder conversations, and market signals gleaned from team conversations and learnings from fundraisers, country directors, and program leads
 Synthesize funder conversations, proposal outcomes, market signals and intelligence generated across the organization into clear fundraising priorities
 Identify where NEX should be focusing time and effort across programs and geographies, based on funder appetite, pipeline strength, and organizational priorities.
 Maintain a clear view of the funding pipeline across the network — by funder, program, chapter, and stage — and flag risks, gaps, or unrestricted-vs-restricted balance issues early.
 Translate strategy into concrete guidance: which opportunities to prioritize, which proposals need repositioning, where the team is over- or under-invested.
 Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and program leads on funding strategy, drawing on patterns across markets rather than any single relationship.
 Team Coordination & Enablement (35%) 
 Lead and develop the global platform-level development team including recruiting, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and managing performance, and ensure team members' skills are effectively leveraged against NEX's development priorities.
 Translate the development strategy into a clear rolling work plan for the team, aligning ownership, resources, and timelines.
 Build strong collaboration across the global development function, bringing together the expertise and fundraising capabilities of platform-level staff, country leaders, fundraisers, and program leads to maximize collective impact.
 Run the operating rhythm of the fundraising team: pipeline reviews, proposal coordination across programs/chapters/finance/communications, and prioritization check-ins.
 Coordinate multi-country and multi-program proposals, including combining country and program inputs into a cohesive narrative and budget that aligns with broader NEX operational and growth priorities.
 Build and own a central library of fundraising collateral - pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, program summaries, impact data - so materials for funder meetings and conference talks can be assembled quickly rather than built from scratch each time.
 Draft and maintain core funder and conference decks, adapting a standard set of modular slides/content to each audience so our fundraisers can focus their time on external relationship-building and speaking rather than deck production.
 Partner with the Chief Communications Officer to keep collateral aligned with current messaging, program updates, and brand standards.
 Provide country leads and fundraisers with the tools, templates, frameworks, and support to raise funds effectively and report consistently.
 Build feedback loops so that what is learned through funder and country-level engagement consistently makes its way back into strategy, priorities, and team planning.
 Systems, Data & Reporting (15%) 
 Accountable for the fundraising CRM and pipeline-tracking systems, ensuring data quality, consistent use across chapters, and useful reporting.
 Produce regular and ad hoc reporting and dashboards for NEX leadership on pipeline health, funder trends, and progress against platform fundraising goals.
 Standardize proposal, reporting, and stewardship templates and processes across the global platform-level team.
 Track outcomes against the fundraising strategy and refine it as new data comes in.
 Ensure fundraising protocols and internal as well as external reporting are completed on time and to consistent quality standards
 SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 6–12 MONTHS
 Success in this role will mean building a more coordinated, strategic, and effective global development function. By the end of the first 6–12 months, the Director will have:
 Established clear visibility into NEX's global fundraising pipeline, priorities, risks, and opportunities, with leadership able to make decisions based on reliable, current information.
 Built a strong operating rhythm across the global platform-level development team, with clear ownership, effective collaboration, and team members' skills deployed against the highest-priority fundraising opportunities.
 Improved coordination across platform, country, and program teams so that high-value proposals are prioritized appropriately, developed collaboratively, and submitted on time and at a consistently high quality.
 Established consistent CRM and pipeline management practices across the development function, with data being used to inform strategy, prioritization, and reporting.
 Created a well-organized, accessible library of standardized fundraising collateral and tools that enables fundraisers and country teams to move more quickly and consistently.
 Established effective feedback loops between funder and country-level intelligence, fundraising performance, and the organization's overall development strategy.
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience across nonprofit fundraising/development, development strategy and/or development operations, including at least 5 years working directly within nonprofit or philanthropic fundraising. Candidates must demonstrate a deep practical understanding of the fundraising cycle, funder decision-making, proposal development and stewardship.
 Strong track record leading the development of complex philanthropic/grant proposals, ideally involving multiple programmes, geographies or internal stakeholders.
 Demonstrated experience turning frontline or field-level input into strategy and prioritization. 
 Demonstrated people-management experience, including coaching, performance management, setting priorities and allocating team capacity. Experience leading a distributed team is strongly preferred.
 Experience operating in a global or matrix organisation, with demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate country leaders, programme teams and other stakeholders who do not report directly to them.
 Comfortable using CRM and pipeline data to support fundraising decisions, forecasting and team management.
 Familiarity with the climate, clean energy, or entrepreneurship support landscape is a strong plus.
 Experience conducting dedicated funder-market or landscape research is advantageous.
 Personal Attributes 
 Structured, analytical thinker who is comfortable synthesizing messy, qualitative field input into clear recommendations.
 High level of adaptability in an environment with evolving team structures and workflows, with a genuine comfort operating in ambiguity - this means being a self-starter and embodying a growth mindset.
 High emotional intelligence — able to lead and support a development team well, build trust with country leads across diverse cultural contexts, and approach unfamiliar markets and norms with genuine curiosity and cultural sensitivity.
 Exceptional written communication skills — able to distill complex, multi-market fundraising intelligence into concise strategy and proposals.
 Strong project management skills; able to run a coordination function across concurrent proposals, deadlines, and stakeholders.
 Comfortable being an internal partner and "connective tissue" role rather than the primary external face of fundraising.
 Ability to work with a global team across time zones, with periodic travel for internal team meetings and relevant conferences/convenings.
 Proficiency in database/CRM management, Google Workspace, and Slack.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Foundational knowledge of global clean energy and climate change solutions and ecosystems and willingness to engage in in-depth self-learning on any gaps.
 Experience building or adding structure to a development operations function from an earlier, more informal stage.
 Due to the global nature of the organization and team, some meetings will take place outside of regular work hours.
 BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.
 Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.
 Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
 As a Managing Director at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.
 What Success Looks Like in This Role
 This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:
 Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
 Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
 Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
 Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
 Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard
 What You'll Do
 Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
 Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
 Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
 Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
 Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
 Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.
 Who You Are
 You've run complex, tech-enabled transformations — perfectly from a top-tier global consultancy or a specialist data & AI firm. You have navigated high-stakes, complex engagements from ambiguity to delivery — and have the results to show for it.
 You have significant experience in Data & AI consulting , with a clear and verifiable track record of personally originating and closing major client relationships
 You are currently at Principal or Associate Partner / Director level — or equivalent — with the commercial track record and client ownership, looking for the next step in your career.
 You don’t need to write code, but you must "speak Tech." You understand data architecture and AI well enough to raise our delivery bar and earn the respect of world-class engineers.
 You bring an established network of senior client relationships in the Canadian market , ideally in financial services.
 Fluent in English. 
 Comfortable with traveling, including on-site engagements.
 What's In It For You
 At Unit8, we don't just "turn data into value" — we empower the people who make it happen. If you are looking for a place where you can say, "I am independent and I take ownership", your next chapter starts here.
 Trust from Day One: We believe in your expertise, and trust is a core part of our culture.
 Work that Matters: You will do things that matter, and together we will facilitate the work of others.
 Passion-Led Projects: We create an environment where you can pursue your passion alongside great talent. If the future makes you excited, you belong here.
 Impact: You will be part of our leadership team and have a direct hand in shaping how Unit8 grows in Canadian market — defining our commercial approach, influencing which industries and clients we focus on, and setting the standard for how we deliver. This is not an execution role inside a fixed strategy; you help write it.
 Competitive compensation package. 
 Flexibility & Growth: Above-the-norm flexibility on where and when you work, with up to 10% of your time dedicated to learning and pro-bono projects.
 Connection & Fun: Whether it's our cross-office off-sites, online events, or a dedicated quarterly team budget for after-work activities, we make sure we stay connected.
 We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you meet the qualifications and are excited about the opportunity to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply.

Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.
 Our Tensix Team is building the next generation of high-performance AI compute systems. We’re looking for a Power Architect to drive architectural strategy, modeling, and design decisions that shape how power is understood and optimized across our products. This is a hands-on role with massive influence over how we build power-aware systems from the ground up.
 This role is hybrid, based out of Santa Clara, CA, Boston, MA, Austin, TX or Toronto.
 We welcome candidates at various experience levels. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.
 Who You Are 
 15+ years experience with power estimation tools like PowerArtist, PtPX, RTL Architect, and PrimePower.
 Skilled in modeling and optimizing power at the architectural level, with deep knowledge of power-gating, voltage domains, and leakage control.
 Track record of influencing architectural and micro-architectural changes that meaningfully reduced design power.
 Proficient in Verilog HDL, Design Compiler, C/C++ and Python.
 Background in power-optimization of compute datapath and/or interconnects.
 What We Need 
 Predict power consumption early in architecture and track it through RTL evolution.
 Propose architectural changes for power optimization across server and non-server markets.
 Build workloads that stress real-world use cases and guide thermal and power-delivery solutions.
 Correlate pre-silicon estimates to silicon measurements and drive power efficiency improvements.
 What You Will Learn 
 How AI workloads impact power at every layer of the stack — from circuit to software.
 Challenges in building accurate, CI-integrated power modeling infrastructure.
 Techniques for aligning design tradeoffs to the realities of AI model execution.
 How Tenstorrent approaches full-stack power optimization across chiplet-based systems.
